description: Take a screenshot of one open extension surface (popup, options, sidebar, newtab, history, bookmarks) or web page in a live extension_dev or extension_start session and save it as a .png file. It asks the browser for that page's own pixels over the session's debug port: CDP Page.captureScreenshot on Chromium, the debugger protocol's screenshot actor on Firefox, and WebDriver on Safari, where only web pages can be captured. It never captures the screen or another window and never brings a window to the front, so there is no need for screencapture, AppleScript or a Playwright script. The surface must already be open: open it with extension_open first. Pass `targetId` (the target.targetId extension_open answers, or one from extension_dom_snapshot listTargets) to capture that exact page; when a url matches several tabs that show the same page, the most recently active one is captured and a warning names the others. width and height set the viewport on Chromium and crop from the top left on Firefox; deviceScaleFactor sets the pixel ratio. The file goes under dist/extension-js/<browser>/screenshots unless `path` names one, and the answer gives its path and pixel size. Use extension_dom_snapshot for the page's structure as text.

browser.description: Session browser; defaults to this project's live session. Required when the project runs sessions for more than one browser: the call is refused with the list rather than picking one.

context.description: page captures a tab picked by `url` (or the only or selected one); the rest capture that extension surface, which must already be open.

deviceScaleFactor.description: Pixel ratio of the image, 0.5 to 4. Defaults to the browser's own on Chromium and 1 on Firefox.

height.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels (Chromium renders at it; Firefox crops to it).

path.description: Where to write the image, relative to projectPath and inside it: a file name ending in .png (shots/home.png), or a folder with a trailing slash (shots/) that gets a timestamped .png. A path outside projectPath, or a file name that does not end in .png, is refused with E_BAD_REQUEST, so no other file is ever overwritten. Defaults to dist/extension-js/<browser>/screenshots.

projectPath.description: Extension project root (needs a live dev session)

targetId.description: Pick one open page directly by its targetId: the target.targetId extension_open answers, or a targetId from extension_dom_snapshot listTargets: true (a CDP target id on Chromium, the tab's browserId on Firefox). When given, `url` is ignored. A target that is gone is refused with E_TARGET_NOT_FOUND, naming the live ones.

timeout.description: Command timeout in ms. When omitted, the default depends on the route: 30000 through the dev session's control channel, 10000 over the Firefox debugger protocol, and 15000 per command over the Chromium debug port.

url.description: page: the tab whose url contains this (a web address or the extension's own page url).

width.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels (Chromium renders at it; Firefox crops to it).

name: extension_screenshot
